summary: Frontend-only Playwright test at 430x932 mobile viewport. 59/61 assertions passed across auth (login redirect, invalid password, valid login, duplicate signup, new signup), Home (topbar 3 buttons, messages-badge '2', 7 story cards incl. story-live-s3, PostCard p1 like toggle 28->29), bottom nav (Home/Explore/Jobs/Nearby/Profile), Jobs page (create/view-toggle/locate/search + 4 filter pills + job-card-j1 with call/message/share + 'Kenai' address + '25' count), Nearby page (view-toggle/notifications/locate/search + 11 category tiles + 4 popular services + SEE ALL), and Profile page (menu-btn, name 'Aarav', @handle, Photographer pill, 4.5 rating, stat-following/followers, Call Now/Website, Posts/Photos tabs, menu opens and logout returns to /login). 2 minor issues found (see below).

ui_bugs.issue: The 'nearby-cat-more' (100+ Categories) tile is not rendered because mockAdapter returns exactly 11 categories and the tile is gated behind `overflow > 0` (only shows when >11). Spec requires the tile to always appear alongside the 11 categories.

issues: Active tab color is rgb(11,13,16) (--ah-ink, near-black) rather than pure black rgb(0,0,0). Visually looks black and matches design intent; only note if strict pure-black is required.

action_items: In NearbyPage.jsx line 108, either (a) always render the 'nearby-cat-more' tile after the 11 categories, or (b) update mockAdapter.js to return >11 categories so overflow triggers. Spec lists 11 named categories PLUS a 100+ Categories tile.
critical_code_review_comments: NearbyPage.jsx: overflow logic (line 18/108) prevents the '100+ Categories' tile from ever showing with the current mock data (11 items). Recommend rendering the tile unconditionally.

Console emits 401/409 errors during expected negative auth flows (wrong password / duplicate signup). Consider swallowing these known-expected fetch errors in AuthContext to keep the console clean, or documenting that they are expected.
test_credentials: demo@abroadhub.app / demo1234 (works). New signup with unique email works. Duplicate signup with demo email returns 'An account with this email already exists.'
seed_data_creation: One transient test user created via signup with email test_<epoch>@abroadhub.app / pass1234 (not cleaned up; users collection may accumulate TEST_ accounts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested testids exist except 'nearby-cat-more'. Login/signup/logout, story ring with Live badge, PostCard like toggle, all 5 bottom-nav tabs, all Jobs testids, all Profile testids and menu-open+logout all verified working. If retesting, use viewport 430x932 and the demo credentials above.
rca of the issue: nearby-cat-more missing: NearbyPage.jsx computes `overflow = cats.data.length - 11` then only renders the more tile when overflow > 0. mockAdapter.getNearbyCategories returns exactly 11 items so overflow = 0. Fix: render tile unconditionally OR add a 12th mock category.
